title: Systems Engineering Officer
description: Systems Engineering Officer MyCart Express Jamaica Kingston and St. Andrew / St. Catherine Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 20/11/2026 HRM Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save We are seeking a capable, solutions-driven Systems Engineering Officer to support and strengthen our growing technology infrastructure and business systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining and improving system performance, managing integrations, supporting software development initiatives and identifying opportunities to improve business processes. This role requires someone who is technically strong, analytical and proactive, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, work with stakeholders, and translate business needs into practical technology solutions. Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain IT systems Monitor, troubleshoot and improve the performance, reliability and security of business systems. Support business applications, databases, APIs, system integrations and data migration projects. Work closely with team and external technology partners to resolve system issues and implement improvements. Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve operational efficiency and reduce manual processes. Support reporting, dashboards, data management and business intelligence initiatives. Implement IT security protocols, backups, disaster recovery procedures and access controls. Coordinate system updates, testing, deployments, documentation and staff training. Explore practical applications of AI and emerging technologies to improve business processes and productivity. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering or a related field. 2-3 years' experience in systems engineering, IT infrastructure or business systems administration (not required but preferred) Knowledge of automation tools, AI applications and software development environments Strong knowledge of networking, cloud environments, cybersecurity and IT infrastructure. Experience working with databases, SQL, APIs and third-party system integrations. Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience supporting multi-location business operations would be an asset. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is hands-on, takes initiative and can work independently. You should be comfortable managing day-to-day technical operations while also contributing to larger technology improvements. Ref: Systems Engineering Officer Apply Now
